method: Retain actual V8 module envelope and exact measured function/method records only. Normalize script URLs to repo: paths. Functions, ranges, counts and isBlockCoverage retain exact captured values. Sources outside the frozen repository contribute only when byte-identical from the dedicated isolated-fixture directory; each origin is recorded. Raw hashes and pre-/post-normalization subset hashes establish provenance without publishing host paths.
limitations: Original raw V8 files remain outside this published subset. Source hashes are checked at normalization time; V8 itself does not store source hashes. Source freeze and final-only collection are required. Whole unchanged upstream init/update/CLI functions are excluded from scope.
